martha: heads-up — hitting an intermittent hang / "Event loop is running" errors in test + prod when our AsyncClient starts a periodic background task from __init__. Happened after we bumped httpx/httpcore versions. repro below.

martha: snippet of how we construct today (simplified):
```py
class AsyncClient:
    def __init__(self, *, heartbeat_interval=30):
        self._hc = httpx.AsyncClient()
        self._hb_task = asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat(heartbeat_interval))

    async def _heartbeat(self, interval):
        while True:
            await asyncio.sleep(interval)
            await self._hc.get("https://status.example")
```

martha: symptoms: sometimes tests hang on teardown with "RuntimeError: Event loop is running" or the background task is scheduled on a different loop and throws "Task attached to a different loop". In prod (uvicorn+gunicorn) we saw intermittent broken requests during scale-up where background task exceptions leak and crash worker.

leo: creating tasks in __init__ is risky because there may not be a running loop at import time, and create_task binds to the current loop. If the object is created in one loop and used in another (tests, workers, forked processes) you get cross-loop futures. Also if you call asyncio.get_event_loop() during interpreter teardown you can hit "Event loop is closed".

anya: for background work recommend explicit lifecycle: don't spawn tasks in __init__. Provide either an async factory that starts any background tasks after awaiting (so it runs on the running loop) or expose start()/stop() async methods. Example factory:
```py
class AsyncClient:
    @classmethod
    async def create(cls, **kw):
        self = cls.__new__(cls)
        self._hc = httpx.AsyncClient()
        # now we are running in an async context -> schedule tasks
        self._hb_task = asyncio.create_task(self._heartbeat(kw.get('heartbeat_interval',30)))
        return self
```

leo: we should also make heartbeat task use asyncio.create_task only after the client is awaited/started. And make _heartbeat resilient to cancellation and log exceptions.

martha: i tried switching to create() and it fixed local pytest-asyncio + anyio jobs. But CI still had a few failures where a session-scoped fixture returned a client created in setup (sync code) and then tests used different loop backends — so we should update our examples and docs.

anya: agree. Also add safety checks: if __init__ ever gets called and detects a running loop, we could warn and avoid scheduling tasks. But better to error loudly: raise RuntimeError in __init__ if trying to schedule tasks — nudges users to use the async factory.

leo: other defensive measures: keep a weakref to the loop in _hb_task and on aclose() cancel tasks and await them. Add explicit timeouts on aclose to avoid hangs in teardown. Tests: add CI matrix rows for pytest-asyncio, pytest-anyio with uvloop and trio backends to catch cross-backend issues.

martha: opened GH issue with repro and logs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/python-sdk/issues/2555 — includes small pytest repo that demonstrates hang and a snippet that forks processes to emulate gunicorn workers. Assigned to @leo.

ci-bot: Created issue #2555 (redwood-inference/python-sdk): "Background tasks started in __init__ cause loop affinity/hangs in tests and gunicorn workers" — assigned to @leo. :white_check_mark:

leo: i'll take this. proposed quick patch: 1) remove create_task from __init__, 2) add `@classmethod async def create(...)` and `async def start(self)` helpers, 3) add clear docs and sample app changes, 4) tests and CI matrix. Also add a lint in samples to detect create_task in top-level constructors.

anya: small gotcha: when migrating, watch for users relying on implicit background refresh behavior (token refresh, cache warmup). We should provide a small compatibility shim that logs deprecation and schedules work only if an explicit `start()` is called.

martha: thanks — switching our internal apps to async factory/lifespan pattern fixed production flakiness during a scale test. i'll post the PR with tests and docs update shortly.

ci-bot: PR #2560 opened by @leo: "fix(async): stop scheduling background tasks in __init__; add async create/start/stop + docs" — CI running.
